claim: The October 2026 /graft-tracking/ spike (Italy, 'grafting app' at pos ~1.8) was real Google search traffic and produced 11 store clicks, but Play Console shows ZERO Italian installs 13-20 Oct, so a store click from that page is not evidence of an install.

body.source: Plausible v2 API (treesmith.app, 2026-09-01..10-21) pulled for the treesmith-web session; Play Console check by Benedict.
body.gsc_vs_plausible: Agree almost exactly: 73 GSC clicks vs 73 Google-referred Plausible visitors for the window; week of 12 Oct 62 vs 62.
body.spike: /graft-tracking/ daily visitors 10-13 19, 10-14 19, then 2-6/day. Italy 49 of 79 visitors 10-05..21, none before 10-13. Sources: Google 70, Direct 8, treestock 1. No article or forum referrer.
body.not_bots: 24 Italian cities, mixed devices and browser versions, visits spread across the clock, Google-referred. Bot-like only: 2 Play clicks on / from CN via Direct on 09-02.
body.engagement: Visits entering on /graft-tracking/: 10-12..15 81% bounce, 10s average; 10-16..21 83% bounce, 18s average. 75 of 76 exits were on the same page.
body.store_clicks: Sep 1..Oct 21: 30 store clicks. / 17, /graft-tracking/ 11 (10 in October), /download/ 2. In October /graft-tracking/ (10) beat / (4), reversing DEC-268's 'every store click came from /'. 5 of the 11 were Italian and 4 of the 11 were desktop.
body.did_not_convert: Benedict checked Play Console 2026-10-22: no Italian installs 13-20 Oct. The Italian Play clicks did not become installs.
body.homepage_baseline: Store clicks on / 2026-09-21..10-20: 8 events / 8 visitors, against DEC-268's 21/17 per 30d. Mostly Benedict's own AU Direct test clicks in mid-September falling away.
body.attribution_shipped_2026_10_22: treesmith-web commit 5dc003a: /download/ fires plausible('Store Redirect', {store, ct}) before redirecting. ct comes from ?ct=, then utm_source, then the referring path, else 'download'. App Store links now use apps.apple.com/app/id6761506742?pt=128328374&ct=<page>&mt=8 (the /au/ storefront has been removed). Play links carry utm_campaign=<page>.
body.ross_creek_qr: QR on the Ross Creek cards: https://treesmith.app/download/?utm_source=rosscreek&utm_medium=qr (ct=rosscreek). Touch date 2026-11-10 unchanged.
body.plausible_goal: 'Store Redirect' goal created 2026-10-22 (goal id 22 on data.bjnoel.com, Plausible CE v3.2.1, via Plausible.Goals.create over server RPC; CE has no Sites API). allowed_event_props is NULL for treesmith.app, so every prop is accepted and no ct/store allowlist is needed. Setting an allowlist would start dropping the url prop on Outbound Link: Click.
